Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.widgets

Enum Class Op

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Op>
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.widgets.Op
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Op>, Constable
public enum Op extends Enum<Op>
The comparison operator of a declarative single-field rule.

One vocabulary, one place. Every rule in the toolkit that tests one row field against one value shares these constants — the action-bar state rule here, and the RowClassRule row decorator in the views module, and the views module's VisibilityRule. It lives in this module because the widgets→views dependency does not exist, so the shared type has to sit on the side both can see.

IN/CONTAINS are collection operators (the value is a list, or the tested field is) used by visibility rules only.

EQ/NE/IN/CONTAINS require a comparison value; PRESENT/ABSENT test only whether the field is non-null/non-empty and therefore omit one. requiresValue() is the discriminator, and every host is expected to reject the mismatched form rather than ignore the surplus value.

Each constant also carries its lowercase wire token, for the hosts that do serialize a rule.

Since:
10.0.0

  • Enum Constant Summary

    Enum Constants
    Enum Constant
    Description
    ABSENT
    Matches when the tested field is missing/null (no value needed).
    CONTAINS
    Matches when the tested field (itself a list) contains the rule's value.
    EQ
    Matches when the tested field equals the rule value.
    IN
    Matches when the tested field equals one of the values in the rule's value list (the value is a list).
    NE
    Matches when the tested field does not equal the rule value.
    PRESENT
    Matches when the tested field is non-null/non-empty (no value needed).
